analysis: The item-bias trial succeeded, reaching host validation macro HR@10 of 0.5713 versus 0.5575 previously (+0.0138). Category HR@10 increased from 0.575 to 0.580 for Movies_and_TV, 0.595 to 0.615 for Industrial_and_Scientific, 0.365 to 0.370 for Electronics, and 0.695 to 0.720 for CDs_and_Vinyl. These results support retaining explicit item intercepts in this configuration, though one trial does not establish the cause or robustness of the improvement. Electronics remains the weakest category. Allocated GPU time was 243.75 seconds; no test results were available.
code_summary: Two-layer, 64-dimensional LightGCN with complete-history profiles using half-life 10 and coefficient 0.5. Training differentiably excludes every occurrence of the positive item from its profile and uses temperature-1 sampled-softmax cross-entropy with 32 uniform unseen negatives. This trial adds zero-initialized trainable item biases to positive, negative, and inference scores, with sampled L2 regularization. Adam uses learning rate 0.003, batch size 8192, and eight steps per epoch. Exported checkpoints and the generated dataset-routed predictor preserve the learned biases. Deterministic fixtures cover target exclusion, bias gradients, zero-bias equivalence, and checkpoint/predictor parity. All four datasets, supplied splits, seeds, early stopping, and single-GPU execution remain unchanged.
